content.question: Are the first stars over the island brighter when I watch them from the high rock, or from the slope beside the lamp?
content.method: At dusk I carried the lamp up to the slope and sat with the telescope pointed at the sky, counting the points of light I could see without moving my head. I did not move the lamp. I kept my eyes on the same three stars for a long time, and when a cloud came I waited for it to pass before trusting anything.
content.result: I counted three stars clearly and one more that might have been a bird's eye reflecting the lamp. The lamp made the nearest stars look dimmer, which I did not expect. The cloud hid the others, so I am not sure the count is right. I will try again on a night with no lamp and no cloud.
